# Architecture of Demo workspace

## Purpose
What the system does and for whom.

## Systems
The main systems and services, with `repo:<name>` keys from `repos.json`.

## Domains
The domains of the system, with `domain:<name>` keys.

## Decisions
Accepted decisions live in `docs/adr/` with `adr:NNNN` keys.

## Diagrams
Diagrams live in `docs/diagrams/` with `diagram:<name>` keys.
